title: WhereUsed
description: The `data` payload of `dmtool -m <model> where-used <entityPath>` (CLI-SPEC §6) — the rules and computations whose condition directly references a given field or group. The inverse of a rule's referenced entities; the per-entity peer of the model-wide `model usage`. Built on the kernel's `getDirectlyReferencedEntities`, so it can never disagree with `model usage` / `rule deps`. `rules` and `computations` are kept as separate arrays (a field read only inside a computation's operation appears under `computations`, not `rules`).

rules.description: the full names of the validation rules whose condition directly references the entity

computations.description: the full names of the computations that directly reference the entity (kept separate from rules)

count.description: rules.length + computations.length — the total referrer count
